content_sections.heading: GGSGH Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the GGSGH Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download GGSGH Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: GGSGH Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 4 vacancies are available - 1 for Medical Officer, 1 for Counsellor, 1 for Staff Nurse and 1 for Data Manager.

content_sections.heading: GGSGH Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Medical Officer: MBBS from a recognized institution along with medical council Registration (Preferable: MD or equivalent qualification in Psychiatry) Counsellor: Graduate in Psychology or Social Work or Sociology. Masters in above disciplines/ Experience one year in similar or equivalent field (Desirable) Staff Nurse: ANM. GNM/BSc Nursing/ Experience one year in similar or equivalent field (Desirable) Data Manager: Graduate

content_sections.heading: GGSGH Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Medical Officer: Upto 45 years (not more than 64 for retired Govt Servant) Counsellor: Upto 35 years Staff Nurse: Upto 35 years Data Manager: Upto 37 years Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for GGSGH Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for GGSGH recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the GGSGH recruitment will be held on 19 August 2026. Candidates are advised to report at the specified time.

faq.question: Q2. What are the different posts announced by GGSGH?
faq.answer: GGSGH has announced vacancies for Medical Officer, Counsellor, Staff Nurse, and Data Manager positions. There is one vacancy for each post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: For the Medical Officer post, candidates must possess an MBBS degree from a recognized institution along with medical council registration. A preference is given to those with an MD or equivalent qualification in Psychiatry.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Counsellor post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Counsellor post is 35 years. There is no minimum age limit specified.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Staff Nurse position?
faq.answer: The Staff Nurse position offers a monthly salary of Rs. 30,240/-.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the GGSGH recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is through a walk-in interview. Interested candidates need to report at the specified venue with all required documents on the interview date.

faq.question: Q7. What documents are required for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring original certificates, ID proof, residential address proof, one recent passport-size photograph, and self-attested copies of all certificates.

faq.question: Q8. What is the reporting time for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should report for the walk-in interview between 09:00 AM and 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for these posts?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for any of the posts.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the interview venue?
faq.answer: The interview will be held at the Establishment Branch of Guru Gobind Singh Government Hospital, located at Block B, 3rd Floor, New Building, New Delhi - 110027.
